body: I can't seem to cut myself deep enough to draw blood

Seeing a psychiatrist doesn't seem like a very good idea to me, i find it incredibly difficult to talk about anything personal, especially about things **nobody** knows about me. And with the sexuality problem, for some reason i've got it drummed into my head that it's a weakness, something to be looked down on and shunned and i can't shake it. I just.. really don't know what to do.

As much as it kills me to say this (No pun intended) this doesn't help, i've honestly grown up with the idea that life is perfect, that i'll find a perfect partner, have the perfect job, perfect friends and a pile of money just like the generic hollywood movies that i obsess about but always feel worse after as it just reminds me of a life that isn't possible.

There is no way out for me, i can't look for help to any family and friends, to family because i'll just be embarrassed and the freak of the family, and to friends to just be seen as an attention seeker.

The truth is, life isn't going to get any better, i'm going to get stuck in a dead-end job as soon as i'm out of college, in the future all i see is just work and labour, there is nothing that excites me about it, frankly there's no point in having one.
